---
title: "Forest Monitoring"
format: html
editor: visual
---

forest <- data.frame(
  PlotID = paste0("P", 1:10),
  CanopyCover = c(35, 42, 51, 58, 60, 67, 72, 80, 85, 91),
  SpeciesRichness = c(12, 15, 18, 22, 25, 30, 34, 37, 40, 44)
)

p <- ggplot(
  forest,
  aes(
    x = CanopyCover,
    y = SpeciesRichness,
    text = paste(
      "Plot:", PlotID,
      "<br>Canopy Cover:", CanopyCover, "%",
      "<br>Species Richness:", SpeciesRichness
    )
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 3, colour = "forestgreen") +
  labs(
    x = "Canopy Cover (%)",
    y = "Species Richness",
    title = "Biodiversity and Canopy Cover"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text")

---
